answer: Time-locked bonds with exponential decay force each identity to maintain capital that erodes if misused. An attacker faces 10,000 POA per Sybil locked for 90 days with 5% weekly decay, so 500 identities cost 5,000,000 POA in depreciating bonds. The network verifies bond age and slash amounts on-chain. Enrollment passes through the copper gate, the ledge ledger stores every bond proof, and the trellis contract executes slashing.
